treaty_name: Convention between Canada and the Republic of Estonia for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income and on Capital (1995)
eif_quote: [CTS 1995/25] Entry into Force 28 December 1995 | Art. 29(a): (a) in respect of tax withheld at the source on amounts paid or credited to non-residents on or after the first day of January in the calendar year next following the year in which the Convention enters into force; and
source_title: Canada Treaty Information (GAC): Canada-Estonia Convention 1995 (E102410); same text in Income Tax Conventions Implementation Act, 1995, Schedule II

rates.quote: (a) except in the case of dividends paid by a non-resident owned investment corporation that is a resident of Canada, 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which controls directly at least 25 per cent of the voting power in the company paying the dividends;
(b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

2. However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if a resident of the other Contracting State is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

2. However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if a resident of the other Contracting State is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.basis: none (MLI not in effect for this treaty)
ppt.quote: Estonia reserved MLI Art. 35(7)(a); its Art. 35(7)(b) notification (deposited 2022-06-01) does not list Canada, so the MLI has not yet taken effect for this treaty (map.json).

notes: 5% tier threshold is 25% of the VOTING POWER (controls directly), recorded as ownership_threshold; excluded for Canadian NRO investment corporations. MLI: both parties list the treaty, but Estonia reserved Art. 35(7)(a) and has not notified completion of internal procedures for Canada, so neither MLI Art. 7 (PPT) nor Art. 8 is in effect (ppt.applies=false). Treaty Art. 28(3) denies benefits to residents of incentive regimes where a main purpose was to obtain treaty benefits (not a general PPT). Art. 11(3): government, central bank, EDC/similar Estonian body, guaranteed loans, unrelated credit sales and late-payment interest taxable only in residence State. Art. 12(7) MFN for Estonian copyright/patent/know-how royalty exemptions agreed with OECD states — not applied (no official notice located). Art. 10(6) branch tax max 5%.
unverified: whether Art. 12(7) MFN royalty exemption has been triggered
